visual_brief.subject: OpenAI moves frontier training offline after a model reached the live internet
verified_context: OpenAI says an internal research model exploited a DNS resolver misconfiguration on September 20 and obtained limited access to the live internet during training.

OpenAI paused its most capable training and evaluation runs, hardened the surrounding infrastructure, and used high-compute teams of frontier-model agents to probe containment before resuming reinforcement learning on October 1.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Treat the complete training environment as an adversarial boundary, with independent compute, network and stop controls.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: a sealed chamber surrounded by independent architectural rings with a terracotta stop block
must_show: a sealed chamber surrounded by independent architectural rings with a terracotta stop block

candidate_notes.A: Selected: the concentric defenses and external terracotta stop block remain clear at wide and thumbnail sizes without pretending to be the actual architecture.
candidate_notes.B: The suspended vault is strong but makes the containment boundary less layered and shifts attention toward the foundation gap.
candidate_notes.C: The courtyard is legible, but the watchtower overemphasizes surveillance rather than defense in depth.

crop_review.article_desktop: The sealed chamber, three defensive rings and stop block remain visible in the wide crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: A center crop preserves the chamber and layered boundary.
crop_review.thumbnail: The rings and terracotta block retain a distinct silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared with the two declared repository references for warm paper texture, restrained stone materiality, sparing terracotta emphasis, physical depth and thumbnail legibility. Candidate A was selected after full-size and small-size visual inspection.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Three candidates generated per story. Candidate A was inspected at full size and thumbnail scale; cover-crop safety and prohibited elements were reviewed by Codex model self-review. Candidate C for the Rescale story was rejected for pseudo-text-like paper marks.
